# AI Verdict

> AI Verdict is a browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge that sends one prompt to ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), and Perplexity AI simultaneously, then synthesizes their responses into a consensus verdict. No API keys required — uses your existing browser sessions.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://aiverdict.github.io/): Product overview, features, pricing, and FAQ
- [Privacy Policy](https://aiverdict.github.io/privacy.html): Local-First data philosophy — prompts and responses never leave your browser

## Product

- Free tier: ChatGPT and Gemini, real-time streaming, dashboard and river layouts, multi-turn conversations
- Pro Lifetime ($39.99 one-time): All four models plus The Verdict Engine — AI consensus synthesis with customizable lead model and verdict prompts
- Available on: Chrome Web Store, Firefox Add-ons, Microsoft Edge Add-ons

## The Verdict Engine

A Pro feature that collects all active AI responses, sends them to a lead model you choose, and synthesizes a single consensus — highlighting where models agree, where they differ, and what the most reliable answer is. The summarization prompt is fully customizable.
